title: Вперёд, Анпанман! Невероятные Наганэгиман и Якисобапанман
originalTitle: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Kaiketsu Naganegiman to Yakisoba Panman
alt: Вперёд, Анпанман! Невероятные Наганэгиман и Якисобапанман それいけ! アンパンマン 怪傑ナガネギマンとやきそばパンマン
description: Yakisobapanman and Uncle Negi try to escort the young Pepper Trio and their important cargo to Vegetable Village in time for the carnival this evening but Baikinman and his gang are trying to steal the cargo. Luckily, Naganegiman keeps showing up to help fight them off, but how? Who could this mysterious masked swordsman be?

en: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Kaiketsu Naganegiman to Yakisobapanman

Yakisobapanman and Uncle Negi try to escort the young Pepper Trio and their important cargo to Vegetable Village in time for the carnival this evening but Baikinman and his gang are trying to steal the cargo. Luckily, Naganegiman keeps showing up to help fight them off, but how? Who could this mysterious masked swordsman be?
